0.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SOFTKNOX_000_000
0.description: Pshhh... Shkohhh...<hex:02100103>Uplander desires knowings of Rival Wings? Softknox makes uplander's braincase wet from many tongueflaps!
0.translation_description: Pshhh... Shkohhh...<hex:02100103>Uplander vuole sapere delle Ali Rivali? Softknox gli riempie il cervello di ciarle!

1.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_Q1_000_001
1.description: What do you wish to know about Rival Wings?
1.translation_description: Cosa vuoi sapere sulle Ali Rivali?

6.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_Q2_000_001
6.description: Which rules will you ask about?

15.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SOFTKNOX_000_010
15.description: Uplanders fight each other with mighty machina of gobmake. Make much mayhem and turn core of enemy into bitty-bits!
15.translation_description: Gli Uplander si affrontano con le potenti machina costruite dai goblin! Quanta confusione, finché il nucleo nemico non va in mille pezzi!

16.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_015
16.description: Rival Wings is a large-scale PvP battle involving up to 48 combatants. Participants are divided into two teams, the Falcons and the Ravens.
16.translation_description: Ali Rivali è una battaglia PvP su larga scala che coinvolge fino a 48 combattenti. I partecipanti si dividono in due squadre: i Falchi e i Corvi.

17.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_016
17.description: Each team is given a core to protect, and the side that destroys the opponent's core is declared the winner.
17.translation_description: Ogni squadra deve proteggere il proprio nucleo: vince chi distrugge quello avversario.

18.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_017
18.description: Should time run out before a core is destroyed, victory is awarded to the team that dealt the most damage to the core and its protective towers.
18.translation_description: Se il tempo scade prima che un nucleo venga distrutto, vince la squadra che ha inflitto più danni al nucleo avversario e alle sue torri protettive.

19.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SOFTKNOX_000_050
19.description: Core is thumping heart of battle. A winner is team that makes core of enemy become bitty-bits.
19.translation_description: Il nucleo è il cuore pulsante della battaglia. Vince chi manda in mille pezzi quello nemico!

20.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_055
20.description: Each team has a core located at its base, and the chief objective is to destroy the enemy's core.
20.translation_description: Ogni squadra ha un nucleo nella propria base e il suo obiettivo principale è distruggere quello avversario.

21.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_056
21.description: The core is protected by a magitek field emanating from two towers.
21.translation_description: Il nucleo è protetto da un campo magitec emanato da due torri.

22.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_057
22.description: As such, before you can strike at the core, you must first destroy the towers and deactivate the magitek field.
22.translation_description: Per poter colpire il nucleo, devi prima distruggere le torri e disattivare il campo magitec.

23.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SOFTKNOX_000_070
23.description: Towers keep core awayharm. If towers upstand, uplander cannot strikesmash core. Uplanders must downbring towers first!
23.translation_description: Le torri proteggono il nucleo. Finché restano in piedi, gli Uplander non possono colpirlo: prima devono abbatterle!

24.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_075
24.description: Each team has two towers that serve to protect the core.
24.translation_description: Ogni squadra ha due torri a protezione del nucleo.

25.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_076
25.description: Each tower, meanwhile, is enveloped in a magitek field that mitigates damage taken by team members.
25.translation_description: Ogni torre è avvolta da un campo magitec che riduce i danni subiti dai membri della squadra.

26.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_077
26.description: When hard-pressed, your towers can provide you with much-needed respite. Be sure to take advantage of their protection.
26.translation_description: Quando sei sotto pressione, le torri della tua squadra possono darti un po' di tregua: sfrutta la loro protezione.

27.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SOFTKNOX_000_090
27.description: Pshhh... Shkohhh...<hex:02100103>Uplander who takeholds power generator takeholds ceruleum! Ceruleum lifeblood of planstrike!
27.translation_description: Pshhh... Shkohhh...<hex:02100103>Uplander che conquista il generatore di energia ottiene ceruleo! Il ceruleo è la linfa vitale dei piani di battaglia!

28.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_095
28.description: A power generator is located at the center of the map. Combatants can take control of the generator by interacting with it.
28.translation_description: Al centro della mappa si trova un generatore di energia. I combattenti possono conquistarlo interagendo con esso.

29.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_096
29.description: While the generator is under a team's control, the stores of ceruleum for all of its alliances will gradually replenish.
29.translation_description: Quando una squadra controlla il generatore, le riserve di ceruleo di tutte le sue alleanze si ricaricano gradualmente.

30.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_097
30.description: As more ceruleum means more opportunities to deploy machina, the power generator's strategic value cannot be overstated.
30.translation_description: Più ceruleo consente di schierare più machina: il valore strategico del generatore è inestimabile.

31.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SOFTKNOX_000_110
31.description: Gobbies crafty-make special machina for Rival Wings. Machina to help uplanders crunch much bone and smash much steel!
31.translation_description: I goblin costruiscono speciali gobmacchine per Ali Rivali! Aiutano gli Uplander a rompere ossa e spaccare acciaio!

32.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_115
32.description: Powerful machina can be deployed and ridden into battle.
32.translation_description: Le potenti machina possono essere schierate e guidate in battaglia.

33.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_116
33.description: There exist three types: the Cruise Chaser, effective against combatants; the Oppressor, devastating against structures; and Brute Justice, the great equalizer.
33.translation_description: Esistono tre tipi: l'Inseguitore, efficace contro i combattenti; l'Oppressore, devastante per le strutture; e Giustizia Brutale, una potenza capace di ribaltare le sorti dello scontro.

34.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_117
34.description: While machina offer many advantages, ceruleum is required to activate them.
34.translation_description: Le machina offrono molti vantaggi, ma per attivarle serve ceruleo.

35.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_118
35.description: Once your team has sufficient ceruleum, you can choose a machina to deploy at the hangar terminal, located near the starting area.
35.translation_description: Quando la tua squadra ha abbastanza ceruleo, puoi scegliere una machina da schierare al terminale dell'hangar, vicino alla zona di partenza.

36.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_119
36.description: Only one machina may be operated per party at any given time, regardless of type.
36.translation_description: Ogni gruppo può pilotare una sola machina alla volta, a prescindere dal tipo.

37.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_120
37.description: In the case of the Oppressor, however, the limit is two per team.
37.translation_description: Nel caso dell'Oppressore, però, il limite è di due per squadra.

38.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_121
38.description: A Brute Justice becomes available to a team for each tower it loses.
38.translation_description: Per ogni torre persa, la squadra rende disponibile un'unità di Giustizia Brutale.

39.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_122
39.description: You can simultaneously operate as many Brute Justices as the number of towers you have lost.
39.translation_description: La squadra può pilotare contemporaneamente tante unità di Giustizia Brutale quante sono le torri perdute.

40.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SOFTKNOX_000_130
40.description: Machina are mighty and can smite muchly, yes, but they need fuel. Uplander must be collecting ceruleum first.
40.translation_description: Le machina sono potenti e possono colpire duramente, sì, ma hanno bisogno di carburante. Prima Uplander deve raccogliere ceruleo.

41.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_135
41.description: Ceruleum is required to operate machina. A maximum of 100 units of ceruleum can be stored by each party.
41.translation_description: Per usare le machina serve ceruleo. Ogni gruppo può custodirne al massimo 100 unità.

42.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_136
42.description: You can build up your ceruleum stores by collecting tanks in the field, controlling the power generator, or defeating enemy team members and mammets.
42.translation_description: Puoi accumulare ceruleo raccogliendo i serbatoi sul campo, controllando il generatore di energia o sconfiggendo i membri della squadra nemica e i mammet.

43.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_137
43.description: As ceruleum is a party resource, it is recommended that you confer with your comrades prior to activating a machina.
43.translation_description: Il ceruleo è una risorsa condivisa dal gruppo: consultati con i compagni prima di attivare una machina.

44.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SOFTKNOX_000_150
44.description: Trusty mammets fight for each team. March on tower and core, and kaboom! Massive damage!
44.translation_description: I fidati mammet combattono per ogni squadra. Marciando contro torri e nucleo, fanno bum! E provocano danni ingenti!

45.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_155
45.description: Mammets are clockwork soldiers programmed to seek out and destroy towers and cores.
45.translation_description: I mammet sono soldati meccanici programmati per cercare e distruggere torri e nuclei.

46.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_156
46.description: They emerge from their own core at regular intervals before striking out on a set route, and will remain in battle for a set duration.
46.translation_description: Emergono a intervalli regolari dal proprio nucleo, seguono un percorso prestabilito e restano in battaglia per un tempo limitato.

47.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_157
47.description: Upon detecting an enemy mammet, they will engage and attack until either side is destroyed.
47.translation_description: Quando individuano un mammet nemico, lo attaccano finché uno dei due non viene distrutto.

48.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_158
48.description: Mammets that arrive at an enemy tower or core will perform a powerful self-sacrificing attack.
48.translation_description: Quando raggiungono una torre o un nucleo nemico, i mammet compiono un potente attacco suicida.

49.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_159
49.description: That is the extent of their programming; mammets will not harm adventurers.
49.translation_description: Il loro programma non prevede altro: i mammet non attaccano gli avventurieri.

50.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SOFTKNOX_000_160
50.description: If uplander downstrikes enemy, spirit of comrades soars! <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Soaring<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> spirit makes for easier downstriking!
50.translation_description: Quando un Uplander sconfigge un nemico, lo spirito dei compagni si solleva! L'effetto <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ascesa<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> aiuta ad abbatterne altri!

51.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_165
51.description: When you defeat an enemy team member, your party receives the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Soaring<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> effect.
51.translation_description: Quando sconfiggi un membro della squadra avversaria, il tuo gruppo ottiene l'effetto <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ascesa<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

52.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_166
52.description: The effect increases damage dealt as well as HP restored, and can stack up to twenty times.
52.translation_description: L'effetto aumenta i danni inflitti e i PV ripristinati, fino a venti accumuli.

53.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_167
53.description: At twenty stacks, Soaring will be replaced with the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Flying High<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> effect, which confers even greater benefits.
53.translation_description: A venti accumuli, Ascesa viene sostituita dall'effetto <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Volo Alto<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che offre benefici ancora maggiori.

54.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_168
54.description: Soaring fluctuates by party, increasing when a party member defeats an enemy team member or destroys a tower.
54.translation_description: Gli accumuli di Ascesa variano da un gruppo all'altro: aumentano quando un membro del gruppo sconfigge un nemico o distrugge una torre.

56.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SOFTKNOX_000_200
56.description: Pshhh... Shkohhh...<hex:02100103>Big questprize awaits winners, so fight well and strikesmash muchly!
56.translation_description: Pshhh... Shkohhh...<hex:02100103>Una grossa ricompensa attende i vincitori! Combatti bene e colpisci più forte che puoi!

57.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_205
57.description: Participating in Rival Wings will earn you <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>experience points<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>PvP EXP<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Wolf Marks<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, with a larger amount being awarded to the victors.
57.translation_description: Partecipando ad Ali Rivali riceverai <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>punti esperienza<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>ESP PvP<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Marchi del Lupo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>; i vincitori ne ricevono di più.

58.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPMOCKBATTLEGUIDE_00441_SYSTEM_000_206
58.description: You will also receive <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Allagan tomestones<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> at the end of each match.
58.translation_description: Al termine di ogni partita riceverai anche <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>tavolette allagane<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
